worlds.name: Eric's Room
worlds.author: Eric (ericrius1)
worlds.description: Eric's placeholder studio room — cyan holographic workshop ready to build in worlds/eric-world.

worlds.name: JP's Solarpunk Meadow
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: A sunlit promenade through wind-blown wildflowers and brass solar arches.

worlds.name: Breezy Plant Garden
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Giant flat-coloured tropical plants from JP's portfolio garden, swaying in the breeze and bending away as you pass.

worlds.name: Kāneʻohe Fishpond
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Hawaiian coastal loko iʻa — turquoise TSL lagoon, basalt kuapā walls, swaying palms, reef fish, and Koʻolau cliffs.

worlds.name: Coral Reef Walk
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: A sandy path through a coral canyon on the sea floor: caustic light, jellyfish, fish schools, a turtle and a manta ray.

worlds.name: Night Loft
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: An open-plan loft above the night city, with warm lamps, a kitchen island and a shiba who follows you around.

worlds.name: Abyss Stepping Stones
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: A crooked path of ancient floating stones high above a chasm of drifting fog, glowing from beneath and trailing smoke, with needle spires rising out of the murk.

worlds.name: Palace Lagoon
worlds.author: Eric (ericrius1)
worlds.description: Earth's Palace of Fine Arts across a mirror-still lagoon at golden hour, seen from a wind-blown wildflower meadow. The first room drawn with weft instead of Three.js.

worlds.name: Laser Forcefield Arena
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Pitch-black light-show gallery with sweeping TSL laser fans, pulsing forcefield walls, and floating refractive prisms.

worlds.name: Alpine Snow Run
worlds.author: JP (jpwhitaker)
worlds.description: Twilight alpine snow promenade lined with lantern-lit sled fences, frosted fir forests, alpenglow peaks, and falling snow.

worlds.name: Bioluminescent Redwood Grove
worlds.author: Eric (ericrius1)
worlds.description: Nocturnal redwood cathedral under shimmering TSL aurora curtains, glowing mushrooms that react as you pass, and drifting firefly spores.

worlds.name: Golden Cloud Observatory
worlds.author: Eric (ericrius1)
worlds.description: Floating marble-and-brass celestial bridge above a sunset sea of TSL clouds, crowned by colossal rotating brass armillary rings.

worlds.name: Honey in da Hood Ya Heard
worlds.author: simplesessions
worlds.description: A twisty road through honey-dripping trees, golden plants, a fire hydrant, and a giant bee in a blue jacket who eats passing birds.
